_**User (2026-11-28 11:00:34Z)**_

Build ONE page: pages/login.html for Highland Horizons (Northern Pakistan tour company).

TECH STACK (strict – university project rules)
- Only HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript.
- Bootstrap 5.3.3 is the ONLY framework allowed. Use the exact same jsDelivr CDN links
  and integrity hashes already used in header-footer-preview.html (CSS + bootstrap.bundle.min.js).
- NO React/Vue/Angular, NO jQuery, NO other JS or CSS libraries, NO npm/build tools.

DESIGN
- Match docs/design-references/login-desktop.png and login-mobile.png (colours, fonts, spacing).
- Extra states from my hand-drawn prototype: docs/prototype-photos/26i-3255_horizontal.jpg
  and 26i-3255_vertical.jpg.
- Left image: assets/images/login-hunza-valley.jpg with meaningful alt text.

SHARED HEADER/FOOTER
- Follow header-footer-preview.html: Bootstrap CSS, then ../assets/css/layout.css,
  <div id="site-header"></div> at top of body, <div id="site-footer"></div> at bottom,
  Bootstrap bundle JS, then ../assets/js/layout.js.
- Reuse the CSS variables (--hh-...) from layout.css.
- Page-specific code goes ONLY in assets/css/login.css and assets/js/login.js.

FEATURES
1. Login / Sign up tabs (keyboard accessible, aria-selected).
2. Sign up: email, password, confirm password, terms checkbox, Create account button.
   Live validation with error messages under each field: invalid email, weak password,
   passwords not matching, terms not ticked. Red only appears on errors.
3. Password strength meter (3 bars: Weak / Medium / Strong) with hint text, updates as user types.
   Show/Hide toggle on both password fields.
4. Simulated accounts in localStorage: signup saves the user; signup with an existing email shows an error.
5. Login tab: email + password; errors for unknown email or wrong password.
   "Forgot password?"

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Password strength indicators require strict color mapping to specific variables. Initial thought leans toward standard yellow for medium strength, but contrast requirements on the light background demand shifting toward a deeper amber shade to remain accessible.

Calculated contrast ratio for the deep amber text against the light background reaches approximately 4.9:1, satisfying accessibility thresholds. Structuring the strength feedback to update targeted elements via data attributes allows independent coloring of the level label while maintaining readable muted text for the helper details.

Utilizing button elements instead of anchor tags inside the terms label prevents unintended checkbox toggling during clicks. Integrating specific attributes triggers the targeted modal overlays directly without requiring custom JavaScript handlers.
</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Animation scope limited strictly to the three specified login files without external libraries. Initial plan to use standard keyframes requires wrapping within accessibility media queries to respect reduced-motion preferences. Keeping durations under 500 milliseconds ensures a professional, non-intrusive visual flow toggled via script classes.

Tab switching mechanism needs a smooth sliding underline indicator rather than simple border toggles. Using a pseudo-element driven by a state attribute eliminates extra markup while achieving fluid horizontal translation.

Transitioning from hidden attributes to visible states automatically triggers panel entrance animations without extra script timers. Attaching temporary shake classes combined with reflow resets ensures repeated invalid submit attempts replay error animations cleanly.

Animating strength meter segments via a horizontal scale transformation on pseudo-elements yields smoother performance than direct width adjustments. Incorporating transform-origin left alongside color transitions achieves fluid left-to-right filling. Button hover states require micro-elevations under two hundred milliseconds bounded by motion preference queries.
</details></think>

Added subtle CSS animations and class toggles across the 3 page files only (all durations ≤ 500ms, wrapped in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, no shared files or git commands used):

### What Was Added
1. **Page Load** ([login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css)):
   - `.hh-auth-showcase` and `.hh-auth-panel` animate with `hhRiseFadeIn` (`400ms`), with `.hh-auth-panel` delayed by `100ms`.
2. **Tab Switching** ([login.html](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/pages/login.html), [login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css), [login.js](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/js/login.js)):
   - `.hh-auth-tabs::after` slides smoothly (`260ms`) between `Login` and `Sign up` using `data-active-tab`.
   - Visible `.hh-auth-tabpanel:not([hidden])` fades in (`hhPanelFadeIn`, `260ms`).
3. **Inputs, Errors & Submit Shake** ([login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css), [login.js](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/js/login.js)):
   - `.hh-field-input` transitions border and focus shadow (`180ms`).
   - `.hh-field-error:not([hidden])` fades in (`hhErrorFadeIn`, `220ms`).
   - `triggerShake()` toggles `.is-shaking` (`hhFieldShake`, `320ms`) on invalid fields when submitting either form.
4. **Strength Meter Bars** ([login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css)):
   - `.hh-strength-bar::after` animates `transform: scaleX(...)` and `background-color` (`260ms`) as password strength changes.
5. **Buttons & Arrow** ([login.html](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/pages/login.html), [login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css)):
   - Buttons lift (`-1px`) with a subtle shadow on hover (`180ms`), and `.hh-btn-arrow` shifts `4px` right on hover.
6. **Success Banner** ([login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css)):
   - `.hh-auth-status-banner:not([hidden])` fades in (`hhBannerFadeIn`, `280ms`).
7. **Reduced Motion** ([login.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/login.css)):
   - All `@keyframes`, `animation`, and `transition` rules sit inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.

### Changed Files

### How to Test
1. Serve the project locally (e.g., `python3 -m http.server`) and open `pages/login.html`.
2. **Page load:** Refresh the page and confirm the left image card fades/slides up, followed ~100ms later by the form panel.
3. **Tabs:** Click or arrow-key between `Login` and `Sign up`—confirm the green underline slides smoothly and the panel fades in.
4. **Inputs & Errors:** Click into an input (smooth focus ring), then submit with empty/invalid fields—confirm error messages fade in and invalid fields do one short horizontal shake.
5. **Strength Meter & Buttons:** Type weak → medium → strong passwords to see the bars fill and recolor smoothly; hover over `Create account →` to see the slight lift and arrow shift.
6. **Success Banner:** Complete signup or login and confirm the green status banner fades in.
7. **Reduced Motion:** In DevTools (Rendering → Emulate CSS media feature `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`), verify all transitions and animations are disabled while tabs, underline, and errors still function.
